tei:div.tei:p: de yang sngon 'gro byang chub sems bskyed nas/ snying dbus 'od gsal 'od zer rab 'phros pas/ phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba rig 'jin mkha' 'gro bcas/ snang srid lha 'dre gnod byed spyan drangs la/ dbus su bla ma rig 'jin mkha' 'gro dang*/ g.yas su yi dam g.yon du chos skyong dang*/ rgyab tu gnod byed mdun du lan chags mgron/ dus gsum pha ma rigs drug sems can bsam/ yid kyis phyag 'tshal sna tshogs mchod pa dang*/ khyad par rang gi thod pa nang nyid du/ lus ni bdud rtsi'i rang bzhin gyur pa la/ yaṃ la sa rlung g.yos raṃ las me 'bar bas/ thod pa'i bdud rtsi yon tan lngar gyur nas/ rang nyid bye ba phrag stong mang sprul nas/ nam mkha'i mtha' khyab mgron la bdud rtsi drang*/ (98)dgyes shing tshim pas tshogs gnyis rdzogs par bsam/ de bzhin phung po dum brgyad dum stong zer/ gnod byed lan chags gang 'dod sbyin par btang*/ rjes la mgron rnams mi dmigs pa yi ngang*/ skye med bsam yul 'das pa'i dbyings la bzhag de ltar mched bya mchod byed rang gis sems/ sems nyid ma skyes ngo bo ngos bzung med/ thams cad gzhi rdzogs rang bzhin nam mkha' 'dra/ bsam rdzogs gdod ma'i chos nyid chen por shes/ dus gsum 'pho 'gyur med pa'i dgongs par phyin/ gzhi gro ka dag ngang du la bzlog de kun 'gro ba gnyis med phan gdag phyir/ rang bzhin gdod nas dag pa'i bsngo ba bya/ 'di ni sngon 'gro bsod nams ye shes tshigs/ bar chad kun sel dngos grub rgya chen 'grub//
